Three coffees before 10am and still running on 2%? You’re not the only one.

An Aviva survey in 2025 found 57% of UK adults feel tired or low on energy. The NHS says most adults need 6 to 9 hours of sleep a night, and putting your phone down an hour before bed is one of the easiest places to start.

A few small things that make the darker weeks easier.

Number 1 has NHS backing. For seasonal affective disorder, the NHS suggests getting as much natural daylight as you can, and for some people a light box helps. Even a grey lunchtime outside gives you far more light than an office.

Number 2 help

Same takeaway night, slightly smarter order.

The latest National Diet and Nutrition Survey found that around 23% of our energy now comes from food eaten outside the home, mostly takeaways and fast food. Small choices on the menu add up when it's a weekly habit.
